description: This source file defines the `AttributeValue` class, which models attribute value data within the shopping web application. The class extends `ShopEntity`, implements `Serializable`, and includes properties like name, description, default status, image, and price, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: AttributeValue
classes.description: A model class representing attribute values in the catalog, including properties such as name, description, default status, image, and price.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: isDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Indicates whether this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: setDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or identifier associated with the attribute value.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or identifier for the attribute value.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price associated with the attribute value.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price for the attribute value.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attribute value.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attribute value.
